pages.text: A working hookah needs $(item)fuel$(), $(item)Shisha Tobacco$(), and either a vanilla $(item)Water Potion/Water Bottle$() or $(item)Dirty Hookah Water$() in its three GUI slots. The Hookah menu diagrams those three inputs around the machine; its vertical ember gauge shows the live fuel reserve. Slot validation prevents unrelated items from being inserted.

Hookah slots:$(br2)$(thing)Left/fuel:$() Bamboo Charcoal, Charcoal, or Coal$(br)$(thing)Shisha:$() Shisha Tobacco only$(br)$(thing)Water:$() a fresh vanilla Potion item containing Water, or Dirty Hookah Water$(br2)Fresh water is reusable, but it eventually becomes dirty from repeated Shisha use.
pages.title: Loading

pages.text: When all requirements are present and fuel time remains, the hookah lights and the shisha's durability begins to drain. While the hookah is active, hold a $(item)Hookah Hose$() in either hand and right-click the hookah to draw smoke.
pages.title: Smoking the Hookah

pages.text: A hose draw uses the same smoking-effect pipeline as pipes, cigars, and cigarettes, based on the $(item)Shisha actually loaded in the Hookah$(). Nicotine, configured additional effects, quality bonuses, and aging bonuses therefore behave consistently. A short hose cooldown prevents rapid effect spam.
pages.title: Smoking Effects

pages.text: A fresh Water Bottle lasts for a random $(item)2–5 fully consumed Shisha loads$(). It then becomes $(4)Dirty Hookah Water$(). The Hookah still works, but hose draws through dirty water give a short $(4)Nausea$() effect. This never deals damage. Remove the dirty bottle and right-click it to empty it back into a Glass Bottle.
